title: 3D Animation Snags at 0.49 Mark
body: ### Tested versions Windows 10 - Godot v4.6.2 Stable - Forward+ - NVIDIA RTX 3060 ### System information Godot v4.6.2.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6614) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900HS with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 15.40 GiB memory ### Issue description I’m using Blender and Auto Rig Pro to Rig, Animate and export 3D Humanoid GLBs into Godot. If I have a looping animation then it’ll hang/snag in the middle on its first loop, but then run just fine on subsequent loops. If its a one shot animation, then it snags each time. I’ve attached a GIF here. Always snags around 0.49 mark. I’ve tried every permutation out of Blender - works no problem there, including baking them, etc. It appears to be a Godot issue given it happens with every animation out of blender and that it does it only the first iteration. I've tried disabling Godots Optimizer. Scales Transforms Applied in Blender. Both Blender and Godot I have at 30fps. There are no secondary controllers or stretch etc. There is no reset track. The animations are not on autoplay. It doesnt matter if I change interpolation mode or wrap mode of the individual tracks. Its only a single model without material and its not complex animation, so I don't think its computationally taxing. ### Steps to reproduce Open The file. Press play button on the animation. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [animsnag_2026-08-03_20-09-12.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30682465/animsnag_2026-08-03_20-09-12.zip)
